# package bip

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet/bip"
```

Package bip provides BACnet/IP data-link endpoint types.

BACnet addresses remain in the root bacnet package. Concrete B/IP endpoints live here so the root API stays transport-neutral for future MS/TP, IPv6 and BACnet/SC modules.

BACnet/IP is IPv4-only: IsValid requires a usable IPv4 AddrPort. IPv6 addresses may be constructed but are not treated as valid B/IP endpoints.

## Constants

```go
const DefaultPort = 47808
```

DefaultPort is the BACnet/IP UDP port (47808 / 0xBAC0).

Endpoint is a BACnet/IP UDP endpoint.

#### func NewEndpoint

```go
func NewEndpoint(addr netip.AddrPort) Endpoint
```

NewEndpoint returns an Endpoint for addr. BACnet/IP treats only IPv4 endpoints as valid (see IsValid).

#### func (Endpoint) IsValid

```go
func (e Endpoint) IsValid() bool
```

IsValid reports whether the endpoint is a usable BACnet/IP IPv4 B/IP endpoint (valid IPv4 AddrPort). IPv6 and zero values are not valid.

OutboundPacket is a datagram to send.

### type Transport

```go
type Transport interface {
	Local() Endpoint
	Send(ctx context.Context, pkt OutboundPacket) error
	Recv(ctx context.Context) (InboundPacket, error)
	Close() error
}
```

Transport is the data-link send/receive abstraction. One client or server owns one Transport and therefore one local endpoint.

Send may be called from several goroutines at once and must not retain pkt.Data after it returns. Recv is called from a single goroutine; the Data it returns is owned by the caller. Close must unblock a pending Recv, after which Recv keeps returning an error. The owner closes it: client.Client.Close and server.Server.Close close a Transport they were given.

#### func ListenUDP

```go
func ListenUDP(cfg UDPConfig) (Transport, error)
```

ListenUDP opens a BACnet/IP UDP socket transport (IPv4, Annex J).

```go
type UDPConfig struct {

	Port int
	// LocalAddr is the host:port to bind; empty binds every address on Port.
	LocalAddr string
	// Interface limits local broadcasts to one interface by name; empty uses
```

UDPConfig configures ListenUDP.
